description: Borrowing USDG against Goldstein's gAIX (a tokenized index fund of AI and tech stock tokens): the price Borro lends at (what a share redeems for at Chainlink's stock prices, less the fund's redemption fee), whether borrowing is paused (every weekend, and whenever a basket price is out of date; repaying always works), the limit (LLTV) and the new-loan limit (three quarters of it), what a borrower pays a year from now on, what is free to borrow, and the fund's own NAV as context. With wallet: that wallet's loan (gAIX posted, what it is worth, what is owed, how much of the limit is used, what it can still borrow, the price at which it can be liquidated) and its gAIX and USDG.
